notes: The Bay Area Reporter, 3 January 1980 to 30 December 1981: the 58 issues of those years in the Internet Archive collection bayareareporter (GLBT Historical Society scans, identifiers BAR_YYYYMMDD). Method as in the 1976-1979 batch: text and leaves rebuilt from each item's _djvu.xml, read by hand with no reader pass. The numbered-address passages were clustered by address and every cluster holding an event word was read, then the passages around fire, closing, moving and opening words with no number. Kept: a named business or institution opening, moving, closing or burning at an address on a stated date. Not kept: owners, managers, bartenders, performers and patrons; a hotel guest arrested after a fire; residents burned out of Brush Place; anniversaries; proposals with no outcome; classified and personal advertisements; places outside San Francisco. A number the story does not print is taken from another issue of the paper and extra.placement_note says which. Not placed at all: Spurs, the Valencia Street bar opened on 1 May 1980, firebombed on 31 October 1980 and gutted by fire on 19 April 1981, whose number the paper never prints; and the city's venereal disease clinic on Fourth Street, which lost its lease in 1980.

coverage.remaining: 1982 to 2005 remain: 1,231 issues in the collection, January 1982 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 58 issues; 4,841 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 520 windows after the advertisement filter in 446 address clusters, of which the 148 holding an event word were read, plus 357 event-word passages, of which the 145 with a fire, closing, move or opening word were read. 35 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text; 9 take their number from another issue. 24 resolved and published on 21 existing pages, one conflict with the assessor's roll stated (291 Duboce). No page seeded. 11 unresolved: 5 thin facts held on parcels with no page (1732 Polk, 1952 Union, 2360 Van Ness, 2155 Polk, 451 Castro), 2 held at 150 Eureka Street, now a condominium whose building year the roll does not give, and 4 whose number EAS no longer has (365 Seventh, 136 Turk, 199 Grove, and 1115 Geary, the Goodman Building). One candidate declined before writing: the Midnight Sun's move to 4067 18th Street, already on its page twice.
